review_state: PARTIAL; test skip validator and contract reviewed with filesystem-only checks; policy/critical-manifest content, computed/aliased skip bypasses, full test skip remediation, remaining inventory and independent critique remain open

paths_reviewed.review_notes: Read-only CLI validator discovers test/spec files while excluding generated/dependency directories and symlinks, parses JS/TS/JSX with @typescript-eslint/parser, records direct .skipIf/.skip/.todo calls and non-computed skip properties, then matches exact path/kind/callee/condition and occurrence count against an allowlist. It also checks required CI shard text/env, manifest membership/classification, and canonical package script wiring. CLI run passed with 36 allowlisted occurrences in about eight seconds; no write/network/DB behavior observed.

The filesystem-only suite checks repository policy/required-shard contract plus temp-fixture cases for ignoring skip-like fixture strings, failing unapproved option skips, exact allowlist condition and count. Temp directories are cleaned in finally. It does not exercise computed-member/destructured aliases, symlink discovery, malicious workflow comments, or malformed policy edge cases.

focused_test.command: PATH="/home/ricardo/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" pnpm exec vitest run --config apps/spa/vitest.config.ts tests/unit/infra/test-skip-policy.test.ts

cli.side_effect_scope: Filesystem scan and parse only; .gauntlet is an ignored directory and its contents were not read; no DB/provider/network/write operation observed.

verification.environment: Both checks ran outside the root Vitest configuration using the standalone SPA config for the test; no database global setup.

architecture_observations: Allowlist matching binds each skip occurrence to exact path, syntax kind, callee, condition and count; duplicate allowlist keys, unmatched findings and count drift fail.

Required shards receive runner-specific checks only for several recognized labels: vitest-integration and critical-process validate coverage-manifest membership/classification; the auxiliary PostgreSQL process and test:redis labels have narrower checks. Unrecognized labels, including policy runner playwright-postgresql, receive only generic path/allowlist and raw workflow text/environment checks.
The scanner relies on AST structure and does not evaluate tests or import their application modules. The CLI currently discovers 36 allowlisted occurrences.

findings_and_limits.observation: Call detection requires a non-computed MemberExpression and property detection also excludes computed keys; forms such as test["skip"](...) or { ["skip"]: condition } are not recorded. Standalone/destructured aliases are also outside the current recognition rule.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Extend recognition or explicitly constrain/validate syntax so computed and aliased skip forms cannot evade the mandatory scanner; add adversarial parser tests.

findings_and_limits.observation: The recursive walker deliberately skips symlinked files/directories. A test tree entry introduced as a symlink can be absent from the inventory scan.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Document/validate the no-symlink source-tree assumption or safely resolve and scan repository-contained symlink targets.

findings_and_limits.observation: Required workflow job/environment checks use a regular expression over raw YAML and substring checks rather than a YAML parser; comments or unrelated text in a job block may satisfy a required-text check.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Consider parsing YAML structurally and test decoy/comment cases before relying on this as strong CI enforcement.

findings_and_limits.observation: The tests execute the current skip policy and critical coverage manifest as inputs and validate structural wiring, but their own full content/provenance/path review remains pending in the 386-path inventory.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Review docs/engineering/test-skip-policy.json and docs/engineering/critical-coverage-scope.json as separate inventory paths.

findings_and_limits.observation: The validator checks selected schema markers and shard entries but is not a complete typed schema validator; malformed nested values may throw or be accepted by substring-oriented checks.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Keep config-schema robustness open until malformed input tests cover the policy and manifest boundary.

findings_and_limits.observation: Round-17 policy review found the required e2e-postgresql shard uses runner=playwright-postgresql, but validateRequiredShards has no explicit branch for that runner. Its E2E paths are not checked against critical coverage manifest membership or test classification.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Add a Playwright runner-specific manifest/classification check and mutation tests for removed or misclassified E2E paths.

candidate_actions.hold_reason: Two source/test paths are hash-stable and the 3/3/CLI checks pass, but policy inputs remain separate pending paths and the scanner/workflow parser has known bypass and robustness limits.

limitations: Primary-operator review only; no independent critique.
The test and CLI are filesystem-only; no DB, network, provider, or application test code execution occurred.
The validator result does not certify all test skip syntax or every developer/CI entrypoint.

follow_up_after_round17.note: Corrected the round-16 summary of runner-specific validator coverage after inspecting all seven policy shard labels. The validator does not explicitly enforce the playwright-postgresql label against the critical manifest.
